rules.text: the case of the following nominal, the presence of a verbal governor, the definiteness and role saturation of the preceding nominal, the linking pronoun and the presence of a response clause are SUPPLIED evidence, never reconstructed from an unvocalized string
the accompaniment reading requires a preceding verbal governor and an accusative following nominal; a nominative following nominal selects coordination instead
the participation test is a strong cue, not a gate: an animate capable nominal may still be construed as accompanying, so animacy never closes the decision on its own
where the case is unrecoverable and both readings are licensed, both are preserved; the emphasis difference between them is not a fact this unit may emit
a nominal state clause requires both the state connective and a linking pronoun; a clause-initial connective is not by itself an oath
